unit_cn: Unit 4 History and Traditions 历史与传统
source: 人教版2019必修二 Unit 4 词表(真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、英国历史与传统/伦敦景点/苏格兰尼斯湖/英国节日饮食主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义;跳过专有名词(Confucius/Achilles 等)。

words.example_en: Building towns and roads was a great achievement of the Romans.
words.example_cn: 修建城镇和道路是罗马人的一大成就。

words.example_en: We were surprised by the amount of noise at the gallery entrance.
words.example_cn: 我们对美术馆入口处的噪音之大感到惊讶。

words.example_en: The family's ancestors once helped soldiers wounded in the war.
words.example_cn: 这家人的祖先曾照料过在战争中负伤的士兵。

words.example_en: We heard it announced that there were no audio guides left.
words.example_cn: 我们听到广播宣布讲解器已经没有了。

words.meaning_cn: 接近;着手处理;方法;途径
words.example_en: It was hard to approach the painting because of the crowd.
words.example_cn: 由于人群拥挤,很难靠近那幅画。

words.example_en: The Normans won the famous battle and then conquered England.
words.example_cn: 诺曼人赢得了那场著名的战役,随后征服了英格兰。

words.example_en: Relax in a village pub with a glass of wine or a local beer.
words.example_cn: 在乡村酒馆里喝一杯葡萄酒或本地啤酒,放松一下。

words.example_en: Four countries belong to the United Kingdom.
words.example_cn: 有四个国家属于联合王国。

words.example_en: The family offered them bread with butter and homemade honey.
words.example_cn: 这家人给他们端来涂了黄油的面包和自制蜂蜜。

words.example_en: The green hills were dotted with sheep and cattle.
words.example_cn: 绿色的山丘上点缀着绵羊和牛群。

words.example_en: Visitors can walk quietly through the ancient cemetery.
words.example_cn: 游客可以安静地穿过这座古老的墓地。

words.example_en: We could get our car battery charged near the square.
words.example_cn: 我们可以在广场附近给汽车电池充电。

words.example_en: One chief advantage of studying history is understanding a country better.
words.example_cn: 学习历史的一个主要好处是更好地了解一个国家。

words.example_en: The Normans conquered England after the Battle of Hastings.
words.example_cn: 黑斯廷斯战役之后,诺曼人征服了英格兰。

words.example_en: Ireland's many green counties are a true feast for the eyes.
words.example_cn: 爱尔兰众多翠绿的郡县是一场真正的视觉盛宴。

words.example_en: Paul wanted to visit the famous family courtyard in Pingyao.
words.example_cn: 保罗想去参观平遥那座著名的家族庭院。

words.example_en: A large crowd had gathered at the entrance of the National Gallery.
words.example_cn: 国家美术馆的入口处聚集了一大群人。

words.example_en: The four countries share the same currency and military defence.
words.example_cn: 这四个国家共用同一种货币和军事防御。

words.example_en: You are likely to experience local culture and customs first-hand.
words.example_cn: 你很可能会亲身体验到当地的文化和习俗。

words.example_en: The UK countries share the same military defence.
words.example_cn: 联合王国各国共用同一套军事防御。

words.example_en: Xiao Kong is a descendant of an ancient Chinese philosopher.
words.example_cn: 小孔是一位中国古代哲学家的后裔。

words.example_en: The rolling green hills were dotted with white sheep.
words.example_cn: 起伏的绿色山丘上点缀着白色的羊群。

words.example_en: I was eager to learn that the city had such a long history.
words.example_cn: 得知这座城市有如此悠久的历史,我十分激动。

words.example_en: She had a copy boxed to ensure that it was delivered safely.
words.example_cn: 她让人把一份复制品装箱,以确保它被安全送达。

words.example_en: Everywhere you go, you find evidence of four groups of people.
words.example_cn: 你所到之处,都能发现四群人留下的痕迹。

words.example_en: The UK is a fascinating mix of history and modern culture.
words.example_cn: 英国是历史与现代文化的迷人结合体。

words.example_en: The peaceful landscape is a true feast for the eyes.
words.example_cn: 宁静的风景是一场真正的视觉盛宴。

words.example_en: We visited the National Gallery to see the famous paintings.
words.example_cn: 我们参观了国家美术馆,去看那些著名的画作。

words.example_en: A generous family offered the travellers bread and honey.
words.example_cn: 一户慷慨的人家给旅行者端来了面包和蜂蜜。

words.example_en: Birds greet the new day with their morning song.
words.example_cn: 鸟儿用晨歌迎接新的一天。

words.example_en: They served bread with butter and homemade honey.
words.example_cn: 他们端来了涂黄油的面包和自制蜂蜜。

words.example_en: The meaning of an idiom is different from each individual word.
words.example_cn: 习语的意思与其中每个单独的词都不同。

words.example_en: Wales was joined to the Kingdom of England in the 16th century.
words.example_cn: 16世纪,威尔士被并入英格兰王国。

words.example_en: Loch Ness was surrounded by beautiful natural landscape.
words.example_cn: 尼斯湖被美丽的自然风景所环绕。

words.example_en: Each country has its own education and legal systems.
words.example_cn: 每个国家都有自己的教育和法律制度。

words.example_en: The Vikings left behind the names of many locations across the UK.
words.example_cn: 维京人在英国各地留下了许多地名。

words.example_en: The Kong Family Mansion is a famous historic site in Qufu.
words.example_cn: 孔府是曲阜一处著名的历史遗迹。

words.example_en: The four countries share the same military defence.
words.example_cn: 这四个国家共用同一套军事防御。

words.example_en: The nearby country of Wales was joined to England long ago.
words.example_cn: 邻近的威尔士很久以前就被并入了英格兰。

words.example_en: Down by the sea, you can hear the roar of the ocean waves.
words.example_cn: 在海边,你能听到海浪的咆哮声。

words.example_en: London is an ancient port city with a very long history.
words.example_cn: 伦敦是一座历史悠久的古老港口城市。

words.example_en: Their cameras were positioned on the hill above the lake.
words.example_cn: 他们的相机被架设在湖上方的小山上。

words.example_en: Stop by a village pub and relax with a glass of wine.
words.example_cn: 在乡村酒馆停下来,喝一杯葡萄酒放松一下。

words.example_en: Knowing British history will help you solve this puzzle.
words.example_cn: 了解英国历史会帮你解开这个谜题。

words.example_en: The roar of the ocean waves makes up the music of the coast.
words.example_cn: 海浪的咆哮谱成了海岸的乐曲。

words.example_en: Breathe in the sweet scent of fresh flowers in the morning.
words.example_cn: 在清晨,深吸鲜花的甜美香气。

words.example_en: There are some great snacks to try near the old street.
words.example_cn: 老街附近有一些很棒的小吃可以尝尝。

words.example_en: Enjoy a delicious traditional Irish beef stew at the pub.
words.example_cn: 在酒馆里享用一份美味的传统爱尔兰炖牛肉。

words.example_en: A striking image can make the reader eager to read on.
words.example_cn: 一个醒目的画面能让读者迫不及待地读下去。

words.example_en: Almost everywhere, you will be surrounded by evidence of history.
words.example_cn: 几乎在任何地方,你都会被历史的痕迹所环绕。

words.example_en: Relax with a glass of wine and enjoy some traditional music.
words.example_cn: 喝一杯葡萄酒,享受一些传统音乐,放松一下。
